description: Security hooks: PreToolUse Bash guard (chặn 8 attack vectors), PostToolUse format-on-edit (prettier/ruff/gofmt/rustfmt với security hardening), SessionStart git status (sandboxed against repo poisoning).

hooks.command: bash -c 'cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null command git -c safe.directory=* rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "=== Git status ==="; command git -c safe.directory=* status -s; echo "=== Branch ==="; command git -c safe.directory=* rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD; }; exit 0'
